thread:
rachel: seeing a cross-region quota blip during the eu->us canary. looks like SSE keepalives from eu-edge are being billed in us-region route buckets. anyone else?
dmitri: yup. spotted at 09:03 UTC. dashboard shows route=stream-chat tokens attributed to us-west even though client connects to eu-edge.
yoav: interesting. runtime logs show keepalive from proxy arriving with shard=eu-2 but console samples associate node_id=us-12. possible mismatch in routing metadata.
rachel: repro: open SSE on eu edge, force a proxy pingback, then resume over us path (we had a brief network handoff). console shows two token increments: one in eu, one in us.
kevin: my theory: keepalive emitted on proxy has shard_id header, but the collector service overwrites region tags based on the ingress node that ultimately wrote the metric. if routing changes during resume, the metric lands under the new node's region.
yoav: that explains why dedupe fails: console dedupe keys = (flow_id, region). if region flips mid-flight we see two distinct keys.
rachel: short-term mitigation idea: emit an explicit "origin_shard" tag from the proxy and ensure collector preserves it as primary for dedupe. console should prefer origin_shard over writer_node for attribution.
dmitri: alternative quick fix: delay finalizing keepalive charge for 250ms to allow resume to reconcile and attach flow_id. small delay rarely impacts billing but collapses most duplicates.
kevin: telemetry change: add keepalive_origin_shard and keepalive_writer_node. then add a dedupe precedence: prefer flow_id -> origin_shard -> writer_node. also mark POSSIBLE_MIGRATION when region differs.
opsbot: canary-deploy: starting rachel/proxy-shard-tag (build #7120) to eu-edge-canary :rocket:
yoav: also need console behavior: suppress quota alerts when spikes are dominated by POSSIBLE_MIGRATION events and overall spike <4% of route throughput. show explanatory banner: "Detected cross-region migration events; suppressing noisy alerts."
console-bot: alert-mute applied to group quota-streaming-edges until backfill completes (job bf-11030).
dmitri: PRs: #8451 (preserve origin_shard), #8456 (250ms hold), #8460 (console dedupe precedence). I'll add unit tests simulating shard flip and asserting single charge.
kevin: can we also backfill the affected 15m window? some customers saw billing spike. backfill queued bf-11031 ETA 1h 20m.
rachel: good. follow-ups: merge PR8451/8456, deploy canary for 30m, run backfill, update changelog and postmortem blurb.
yoav: long-term: make flow_id propagation mandatory at proxy handoff so region flips don't create new logical sessions. opened ticket T-2247.
kevin: added dashboard annotation for the canary window and a quick query to list POSSIBLE_MIGRATION samples.
opsbot: canary completed on eu-edge-canary; monitoring window started.
dmitri: after 18m looks good. duplicate charges down ~94%. promoting to 50% edges.
console-bot: backfill job bf-11031 started :white_check_mark:
rachel: thanks team. i'll file the retro note and close this thread once backfill finishes.
kevin: adding a small integration test that simulates a network handoff across regions and asserts dedupe behavior.
yoav: closing thread for now.
